limitations: The labels cover twelve frozen symbol intervals in two pinned source files. They do not estimate repository, language, API, cryptographic correctness, runtime use, or broad scanner accuracy.

All twelve coordinate intervals are distinct and non-overlapping. U08 and U10 share a documentation line, and all units remain a deliberately selected, correlated sample rather than independent random observations.
Positive and negative units were deliberately selected. Their proportions are not a prevalence estimate.

Independence is based on reading pinned source and NIST primary definitions without scanner results, tuning observations, rules, or another annotation file. The model identity and agreement with another same-model agent do not independently certify accuracy.

The FIPS 203 PDF fetch timed out twice. Its authoritative NIST publication page abstract was successfully read and explicitly defines all three parameter-set names; no additional cryptographic correctness claim is made.
No upstream code was executed or imported. No scanner, tests, builds, benchmarks, or unrelated network requests were run.
Only source symbols and surrounding local declarations establish the Rust identifier mappings. The review does not validate the complete algorithm implementations.
